milestones.title: Directory: distributors and MBP as editable data
acceptance_criteria: The two received spreadsheets are rows in Postgres and an administrator lists, searches, creates, edits and deactivates them.

milestones.title: Cart from a sketch
acceptance_criteria: A finished sketch becomes a cart of real B2B products with packs and reference prices, on the web and on WhatsApp, and buying leaves a pending order.

milestones.title: Pending orders answered with a link
acceptance_criteria: An administrator works the pending orders and the person receives the Shopify link.

milestones.title: Order to a nearby distributor
acceptance_criteria: A person types an address, picks one of the nearest distributors and that distributor or the fixed mailbox receives the order as a PDF.

subplans.title: Distributor and MBP tables and import
subplans.outcome: Postgres holds the 670 points of sale with coordinates and the 472 MBP; a repeatable import command reports added, updated, skipped and rejected rows and never overwrites a hand-edited row.

subplans.title: Directory administration screens
subplans.outcome: An administrator with the directory permission lists, searches, filters, creates, edits and deactivates distributors and MBP from Administración.

subplans.title: Catalogue port, cart and orders core
subplans.outcome: One catalogue port (crosswalk adapter, SKU from catalog_variants) turns sketch lines into product lines; carts and orders persist in Postgres with an immutable order snapshot; buying is idempotent.

subplans.title: Cart on the web sketch
subplans.outcome: On /boceto a person adds the sketch to the cart, changes packs, removes lines, sees prices and total, and buys.

subplans.title: Cart in the WhatsApp assistant
subplans.outcome: After a sketch result the assistant offers the cart; the person views it, changes it and buys without leaving the chat.

subplans.title: Orders panel and link reply
subplans.outcome: An administrator with the orders permission lists orders, copies SKUs, pastes the Shopify link and sends it (WhatsApp inside 24 h, otherwise e-mail), and marks orders paid or cancelled.

subplans.title: Nearest distributors, order PDF and e-mail
subplans.outcome: A typed address returns up to five nearest active Colombian distributors; a distributor order produces the designed PDF and an e-mail with it attached, routed by the recipient rule, with the no-recipient state when nothing is configured.

subplans.title: Distributor flow on the web and WhatsApp
subplans.outcome: From the cart, on both surfaces, the person types the address, chooses a distributor, confirms the data-sharing notice and gets the distributor's name, address and map link.
